title: Let praise dye the whole life true
summary: Praise is not decoration; it dyes the self with truthful color until action begins to carry that hue.
takeaway: Let praise color the next truthful act.
lifeApplication: When comparison tightens your spirit, turn to praise and then do one truthful thing without advertising it.

source.shortMeaning: Praise absorbed into the Lord dyes the life with the deep color of truth.
source.lifeApplication: When comparison tightens your spirit, return to praise and one truthful act.

evidence.coreClaim: Praise absorbed into the Lord dyes the life with the deep color of truth.
evidence.turn: The shabad uses metal merging and crimson dye to show praise becoming a changed self, not a passing mood.
evidence.practicalImplication: When comparison tightens your spirit, turn to praise and then do one truthful thing without advertising it.
